figures.caption: FIGURE 1 New configuration enables stable cycling of low-external-pressure anode-free ASSLSBs. (a) Schematic illustration of the anode-free solid-state cell configuration. (b) MSD plots of Li, I, S, and P atoms in Li2S-PI3 8% composite obtained by AIMD at 800 K. (c) Radial distribution functions (RDF) of P–S, P–P, and Li–I pairs in Li2S-PI3 8% composite. (d,e) Snapshots of the equilibrium Li2S-PI3 8% structures obtained after AIMD simulations with different thermal protocols.

FIGURE 2 Structural and chemical evolution of the Li2S-PI3 composites. (a) XRD patterns of Li2S-PI3 composites with different PI3 contents. (b) Rietveld refinement of the XRD pattern for the Li2S-PI3 8% composite. (c) MAS NMR spectra for 7Li and 31P of the Li2S-PI3 8% sample. XPS spectra of the P 2p (d) and S 2p (e) regions of the Li2S-PI3 8% sample. (f) Raman spectra of pristine Li2S and Li2S-PI3 8% composite. (g) TEM image of the Li2S-PI3 8% sample, and the inset figure is the corresponding FFT analysis. (h) Selected-area electron diffraction patterns of the Li2S-PI3 8% sample. (i) HRTEM image of the Li2S-PI3 8% sample.

FIGURE 3 Enhanced ionic transport and reaction kinetics in Li2S-PI3 8% cathodes. (a) Ionic conductivities of Li2S and Li2S-PI3 samples with different PI3 contents. Linear sweep voltammetry profiles (b) and CV curves (c) of pristine Li2S and Li2S-PI3 8% cathodes. (d) Schematic illustration of the selected electrochemical states for impedance analysis during charge and discharge. Nyquist plots and corresponding DRT spectra of Li2S-PI3 8% cathode (e) and pristine Li2S cathode (f).

FIGURE 4 Electrochemical performance of half-cells. Voltage-capacity curve for Li plating (a) and stripping (b) in the initial cycle of Li–Cu and Li– Na half-cells. The Nyquist plots during the first three cycles of the Li–Cu half-cell (c) and Li–Na half-cell (d). Half-cell long-term cycling test: coulombic efficiency during cycling (e), and corresponding voltage–time curves (f). Cross-section SEM image of a Li–Na half-cell after 1 mAh cm−2 Li plating (g) and followed by stripping up to a 15 mV cutoff (h).

FIGURE 5 Electrochemical performance of Li2S-PI3 X% cathode. (a) Initial charge/discharge curves for Li2S-PI3 X% cathode at 0.05 C. (b) Rate performance of the full-cell (color scheme matches Figure 5a). (c) Galvanostatic charge/discharge curves at different rates for the Li2S-PI3 8% cathode. Long-term electrochemical performance for the Li2S-PI3 8% cathode: (d) Charge/discharge curves from 1st to 200th cycles at 0.5 C, (e) cycling performance at 0.5 C, and (f) cycling performance at moderate loading (2.52 mg cm−2). (g) Comparison of the current work with previous reports on anode-free batteries.

FIGURE 6 Pressure measurement of Li2S-PI3/LPSCBr/Na full-cell. (a) Schematic diagram of a battery pressure testing device and battery structure. (b) First-cycle discharge capacity of activated full cell at 0, 1, and 4 MPa. (c) Long-term cycle performance of full-cell under different pressures. (d) External pressure evolution during full-cell cycling at 4 MPa, the inset figure shows the voltage curve corresponding to the pressure changes during specific time intervals. (e) Impedance spectra of the full cell after 10 cycles at different pressures.
